description.text: Granite-4.1-3B-Medical-Reasoning is a fine-tuned 3-billion parameter model optimized for complex clinical reasoning and medical question-answering. By leveraging chain-of-thought (CoT) fine-tuning on medical reasoning traces, the model generates explicit step-by-step diagnostic reasoning inside <think> tags prior to delivering a final medical conclusion.
